findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name filelock time-based race conditions
 * @description Detect use of time.sleep-based polling that may contribute to race conditions.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/filelock-time-sleep
 * @tags reliability
 *       external/cwe/cwe-362
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where call = API::moduleImport("time").getMember("sleep").getACall()
select call, "time.sleep used for lock polling; review for potential race conditions and performance issues."
findings.hypothesis: filelock may use time.sleep-based polling for locks, leading to race conditions or performance issues

message.text: time.sleep used for lock polling; review for potential race conditions and performance issues.
